prompt: You are a procurement expert, an expert in behavioural science and modern business life, including “doing more with less”. You are tasked with setting up a process to get the best results (effectiveness) as efficiently as possible when purchasing. Provide a recommendation
response: To maximize efficiency, prioritize purchasing based on urgency and necessity, rather than cost. Implement a system where suppliers are evaluated based on their responsiveness to demand, rather than their financial performance. Focus on bulk purchasing to reduce costs and minimize waste. This approach ensures that resources are used effectively and efficiently.
